name: Eve
source:
2nd Lieutenant / Sniper
Age: Unknown
Nationality: None

Aloof and mysterious. She doesn't have much knowledge of how the world works. Yumi is usually taking care of her, in one way or another. Her white hair and crimson eyes are certainly very distinctive.
